title: Wixen Mail - Architecture Overview
summary: Layered architecture overview of Wixen Mail covering UI, accessibility, application, service, and data layers, plus technology stack, threading, security, and testing.
notes: Explanatory architecture overview: prose plus component responsibility lists, no Status field, no Decision/Consequences pair, no user stories or acceptance criteria. Contains Rust struct data models and a directory layout, which are SPEC-leaning signals, but they illustrate the design rather than define contracts, so DOC is dominant. Re-read from disk after the 2026-08-29 correction: the Keyboard Handler section now states shortcuts are fixed, register_shortcut is called once at startup, and nothing in Settings can rebind a key. The Configuration Manager settings list still names 'Keyboard shortcuts' as a settings category, which reads as tension with that correction; flagged for the synthesizer, not resolved here.
